import json, os, resource
from pathlib import Path
from scripts.wdpa_processing_gate import source_digest
root = Path('/sys/fs/cgroup')
files = [Path('/proc/self/cgroup')]
for directory in (root, root / 'cpu', root / 'cpu,cpuacct', root / 'memory'):
    files.extend(directory / name for name in (
        'cpu.max', 'cpu.cfs_quota_us', 'cpu.cfs_period_us',
        'memory.current', 'memory.max', 'memory.peak',
        'memory.usage_in_bytes', 'memory.limit_in_bytes', 'memory.max_usage_in_bytes',
    ))
print(json.dumps({
    'event': 'wdpa_runtime_inspection',
    'scope': 'runtime-inspection-not-acceptance',
    'source_tree_sha256': source_digest(),
    'kernel': os.uname().release,
    'cpu_affinity_count': len(os.sched_getaffinity(0)) if hasattr(os, 'sched_getaffinity') else None,
    'cgroup_root_entries': sorted(p.name for p in root.iterdir()) if root.exists() else [],
    'files': {str(p): p.read_text()[:8192] if p.is_file() else None for p in files},
    'cgroup_mounts': [line for line in Path('/proc/self/mountinfo').read_text().splitlines() if ' /sys/fs/cgroup' in line] if Path('/proc/self/mountinfo').exists() else [],
    'process_rss_peak_bytes': resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss * 1024,
}, sort_keys=True), flush=True)
